availableCommands.name: blender
availableCommands.description: Build, edit, animate and render 3D content in Blender with Python (bpy), usually headless. Covers modeling objects and assemblies from a description or reference image, recreating a photographed scene, laying out environments from a tabletop to a landscape or city, animation (keyframes, paths, physics, camera moves), lighting, materials and still or video renders, each checked with renders. Use whenever a task involves Blender, bpy, a .blend file, 3D modeling, a procedural 3D scene, or rendering a 3D image or animation. Matching a reference image requires its critic loop: when the workflow tool is available, launch the shipped workflows/critic_loop.js right after viewing the reference (it builds, then runs blind critic rounds and fixes); otherwise an observation sheet, then every round a blind review and seven specific critics, until `critic.py check` passes.
